international.title: Iranian singer and four others receive lashes after performance without hijab
international.summary: Western governments and human rights groups have criticised flogging as torture and a violation of international law An Iranian singer and four members of her production team ⁠have each received 74 lashes after being sentenced for “offending public decency by producing and ⁠publishing obscene and ⁠immoral ​content online”, an Iranian news website said on Monday. Parastoo Ahmadi and the four ⁠others were also handed two-year bans on artistic and musical activities and travel, the Emtedad website ⁠quoted lawyer Mostafa Nili as saying. Continue reading...
